title: Week 4 big update on badaboomtaxi.io: new fare system and quests, 7 redesigned districts, first person view, and most importantly, light trails on the brakes.
author: timcorin
selftext:
A few new things to take a gander at:

\- A new fare system. Pick passengers up from the green rings, fly them through the city to the yellow drop-off, and collect tips on the way. 

\- Quests. everybody loves quests

\- More ads! because the old ones looked like crap

\- More districts with better visual distinction

\- First person view



Drop some feedback please.



Still runs in your browser on phone or desktop, and it's still FREEEE.



[https://badaboomtaxi.io](https://badaboomtaxi.io)

comments.author: L_AIR
comments.body: This is so cool! Do you think you will ever make the step to turn this from an endless runner into an open world type of game like the New York Racing game?

replies.author: timcorin
replies.body: Going open world comes with a lot of technical challenges. I tried it and it felt less fun, especially on mobile. I could try again.

replies.author: thecrownforge

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Its a good start, what are going to make your core loop going to be?

replies.author: timcorin
replies.body: Once i have taxi selection level progression idea will be you can unlock new taxis, upgrade them, in order to get further and into new districts with the aim to get an ever higher score. I want to keep it pretty simple and high score based i think. And can also add achievement such as see all districts, crash into each car at least once, etc. I mean if you have any other ideas, let me know!
